name: Cable Incline Triceps Extension
how_to:
Step 1: Setup and Starting Position
- Adjust an incline bench to a 45 to 60-degree angle and place it near a low cable pulley.
- Attach a straight bar or rope handle to the cable machine.
- Lie on your back on the bench and grasp the handle from underneath, with your hands shoulder-width apart.
- Extend your arms straight up, positioning them perpendicular to the floor.
Step 2: Execution
1. Slowly lower the handle behind your head by bending your elbows.
2. Keep your upper arms stationary while allowing only your forearms to move.
3. Lower the handle until you feel a deep stretch in the triceps.
4. Pause briefly, then extend your arms to return to the starting position.
5. Repeat for 8 to 12 reps, completing 3 to 4 sets.
